block-images-sync.description: Draw the block thumbnails and icons the admin shows, from shared shapes, in one colour that reads on light and dark

block-meta-sync.description: Regenerate the block metadata the block gallery reads from the registered Payload blocks

externalize-deps-sync.description: Guard private manifests for internal libs importing un-bundleable deps

lockstep-versions-sync.description: Keep each dependency family released in lockstep on one exact version in the root package.json

theme-sync.description: Regenerate every stylesheet and registry derived from the committed themes, and fail if a theme is short of the token contract

theme-write.description: Replace a built-in theme's colours with a theme studio export, leaving everything else in its folder untouched
